decision_free_fix: (1) Hydrate reconciliation by updatedAt, CMS and components: in cmsSync, load the local collections into a Map. For each remote collection, if it is missing locally OR `remote.updatedAt > local.updatedAt`, write it, and always re-list its entries, writing each entry that is missing locally or newer remotely. Leave tombstones and persisting site variables with the project (A01-5) for PD-36 and a later step.
